details:
- Enable repo_gpgcheck=1 on the [rhel7-els] repo so yum verifies the
  signature of the repository metadata (repomd.xml.asc)
- Ship the TuxCare signing key from the source tree and pin its fingerprint
  at build time instead of downloading it during the build
- Seed yum's per-repo metadata keyring in %posttrans so unattended yum
  runs keep working after the upgrade
- %posttrans: build gpgdir-ro the way yum does (0755 copy of gpgdir plus
  yum's gpg.conf) so non-root yum can verify metadata too; every gpg call
  uses --homedir (no ~/.gnupg side effect); Requires(posttrans) gnupg2 gawk
- %posttrans: also seed this host's persistdir on a fresh install, and build
  the keyring in a temporary directory that replaces gpgdir only once the
  key is in it with ultimate trust (no half-seeded keyring on failure)
